title: qPCR
author: Lele Sun

steps_raw.instruction: 1- Wear clean gloves;
2- Clean pipettes and stand with 75% alcohol;
3- Thaw DNA samples and all reagents ((2× TaqMan Gene Expression Master Mix (Applied BioSystems), primers (10μM) and probes (10μM));
4- Gently mix the DNA samples and mix thoroughly the reagents on the vortex.
5- Centrifuge the DNA samples and reagents with a spin;
6- Keep reagents on ice;
7- Label the microtubes and leave them ready for preparation of the mix.
8- Required equipment: ABI Step One Plus real-time PCR system (Applied BioSystems)
9- Required consumables: 96-well plates (100ul)

1- Prepare the reaction mix for the number of reactions needed according to the guidelines in the Table 1. Assemble all required components except the sample, dispense equal aliquots into each reaction well, and add the sample to each reactions tube as the final step.
Table 1. Preparation of the reaction mix.
2- Mix thoroughly the plates on the vortex, and centrifuge briefly.
Themal Cycling Conditions
1- Thermal cycling conditions are showed in Table 2.
Table 2. Thermal cycling conditions.
2- Fluorescent accumulation data were analyzed using the ABI StepOne Software Version 2.2.2 (Applied Biosystems).
Component | Volume per reaction, μl | Final concentration
2× TaqMan Gene Expression Master Mix | 10 | 1×
(10μM) Forward primer | 1.8 | 900nM
(10μM) Reverse primer | 1.8 | 900nM
(10μM) Probes | 0.5 | 250nM
RNase-/DNase-free water | 1.9
Temperature, ℃ | Time | Number of Cycles
